header.title: Action required
header.description: Replies, drafts and follow-ups that need a person's decision before the CRM moves on.

kpi.queueHint: Every record waiting on a person: new replies, drafts to approve, AI changes to confirm, follow-ups past due and processing errors.
kpi.draftsHint: Drafts the AI has written that nobody has sent, edited or discarded yet. Hover a row's draft to read it, then Edit or Send.
kpi.followUpsContext: Drafted or past their scheduled time
kpi.followUpsHint: Follow-ups waiting on a person: drafts to approve, and scheduled steps past their time with nothing drafted yet. Select to show only these.
kpi.errorsContextFailed: Processing failed — open the record to retry
kpi.errorsHint: Records whose classification, drafting or sending failed. Select to show only these.

frame.title: Queue
frame.detailCount: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} · newest reply first
frame.detailCountFiltered: {count, plural, one {# item matches} other {# items match}} these filters · newest reply first

empty.noMatchDetail: The queue has items, just none that fit every filter you picked.
empty.caughtUpDetail: New replies, drafts to approve and due follow-ups will show up here.

actions.rowGone: {message} — this contact no longer needs attention.
actions.classificationUpdated: Classification updated — a new draft is being written
actions.classificationTitle: Fix classification — the AI misread this reply

table.caption: People and CRM actions requiring review

draftState.outOfDateHint: A newer reply arrived — edit before sending
draftState.confirmDeliveryHint: Open the record to confirm the last send
draftState.needsReplyHint: No draft yet — write one on the record

row.sendTitleBlocked: This draft cannot be sent as-is; edit it first

regenerate.title: Regenerate this draft
regenerate.description: Tell the AI what to change. It rewrites the reply with your notes and the current draft in front of it.
regenerate.placeholder: e.g. Too long and too salesy. They asked about pricing — answer that first, then offer the 20-minute call.

shorter.label: Shorter
shorter.text: Make it shorter — three or four lines at most.

lessFormal.label: Less formal
lessFormal.text: Less formal, more like a person writing.

answerQuestion.label: Answer their question
answerQuestion.text: Answer their actual question before anything else.

lessSalesy.label: Less salesy
lessSalesy.text: Drop the sales pitch; just be helpful.

moveStage.successReply: Stage moved — the first reply is being drafted
moveStage.title: Move stage
moveStage.description: Something happened outside the conversation — record it and move this lead on.
moveStage.whatPlaceholder: e.g. They want pricing for 50 seats; loop in their CTO
moveStage.explanation: The AI's reading of the last reply stays as it was. Add to follow-ups treats the new stage's first reply as already handled and schedules its follow-ups; Draft a reply now writes that first reply for you to send. Either way, the drafts use this note.

editor.blockedDetail: This person is marked as Do Not Contact.
editor.staleTitle: This draft may be out of date
editor.staleDetail: A newer reply changed the conversation. Regenerate, or open the record to review before sending.
editor.replyPlaceholder: {channel, select, linkedin {Write a LinkedIn reply…} whatsapp {Write a WhatsApp reply…} other {Write an email reply…}}
